issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 specifies counting swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution implementation uses a threshold of 2000 (Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000). This mismatch between the described requirement and the provided solution will confuse students and cause automated checks or example solutions to disagree with the task description.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Either update the solution to use 'Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000' so it matches the problem statement, or change the problem statement text to require '> 2000' if that was the intended requirement. Preferably change solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line 4 from 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000' to 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000'.
